thread:
Alex: Hey CSops — kicking off a short 3-day 'CRM surgeon' sprint to address account duplicates, healthscore drift, and noisy playbook fires. Goal: reduce false positives by ~30% and get a clean staging run before a small prod pilot.
Sam: Love it. What's the scope? Filters + scripts or infra changes too?
Alex: Scope = dedupe rules + contact canonicalization, healthscore decay tuning, and playbook debounce config. Dry-run staging first, then 5% pilot in prod if metrics look good. ETA end of week.
Tess: I'll own the dedupe rules + sample queries. Sharing initial SQL to find dupes: 
```
SELECT email, array_agg(contact_id) AS ids, count(*) AS cnt
FROM contacts
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY email
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
Sam: @Tess can you add account join so we can differentiate same-email across separate accounts vs true dupes? e.g. join accounts on contacts.account_id.
Tess: Yep — will include account_id, last_seen, and source system to prioritize canonical owner.
Jana: I can run the healthscore simulation once you share the rules. I need the renewal-risk prompt set and the baseline weights. Where should I drop them?
Alex: Put samples in our shared sprint folder: /drive/cs/healthscore/sprint-1715 and tag files with sprint-1715. We'll use playbook-bot to run regression tests against staging.
playbook-bot: plan queued for staging dry-run at 2024-06-14T15:00Z. Steps: 1) snapshot contacts+accounts, 2) run dedupe dry-run (no writes), 3) apply healthscore tuning in simulation, 4) run playbook debounce emulation, 5) output metrics (duplicates_detected, duplicates_marked_for_merge, healthscore_mean, playbook_trigger_rate). React with :white_check_mark: to confirm owners.
Sam: :white_check_mark: I'm in. Quick debounce config suggestion: 
```
debounce_window_hours: 12
max_triggers_per_account_per_window: 3
backoff_policy: linear
```
Tess: Adding that to the playbook config. Also adding runbook notes for rollback: keep snapshot id + revert mapping script. Metrics to watch: duplicates_removed, avg_healthscore, playbook_triggers_per_account, false_positive_rate_estimate.
Jana: For feedback capture, I'll add a short post-onboard webhook to collect onboarding NPS + top-3 blockers. Draft survey link: https://forms.redwood.ai/sprint1715 (will be internal only for the pilot).
Alex: Nice. Pilot plan: after successful dry-run we'll roll 5% of new onboarded accounts in prod on Monday morning. Owners: @Tess = dedupe rules & sample data, @Sam = debounce config + infra PR, @Jana = metrics & survey wiring, @Alex = rollout coord + runbook.
Sam: I'll open the infra PR and tag eng-sre for canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/987 — includes feature flag + config.
Tess: Uploading a small CSV of detected duplicates to the sprint folder for review (sprint-1715/dupes-sample.csv).
Alex: Thanks all. Short sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: demo dry-run output, confirm metric thresholds for pass/fail, deploy checklist, and rollback steps.
playbook-bot: acknowledgement: owners noted (Tess, Sam, Jana, Alex). Dry-run scheduled; will post results to #cs-ops-results when complete. :robot_face:
